title: Kuiil
subtitle: Independent
description: The diminutive Ugnaught Kuiil lived a peaceful life as a moisture farmer on the distant planet of Arvala-7. His life took a turn when he first encountered the Mandalorian, Din Djarin. Kuiil offered assistance to the Mandalorian after Jawas stripped his ship and the pair travelled together back to nevarro. Unfortunately, that's where Kuiil met his noble end.
